cases.title: German FY2023 field audit — royalty rate challenge (HoldCo IP licence)
cases.counterparty: Bundeszentralamt für Steuern (German Federal Central Tax Office)

checklist.label: Log and triage outstanding IDRs (information document requests)
Refresh royalty benchmarking study for the audit year
Assemble DEMPE functional evidence for the licensed IP
Draft rebuttal memo on the proposed royalty rate adjustment
Brief tax leadership on settlement vs. litigation posture

cases.notes: Examiner is challenging the 6% intra-group royalty as exceeding the arm's-length range; primary issue is comparability of the licensor's DEMPE functions.

cases.title: India TP assessment — marketing intangibles / AMP (bright-line)
cases.counterparty: Income Tax Department — Transfer Pricing Officer (Mumbai)

checklist.label: Quantify AMP (advertising/marketing/promotion) spend vs. comparables
Analyse bright-line test and economic ownership of marketing intangibles
Identify domestic comparables rejecting the TPO's set
Prepare written submission ahead of the hearing

cases.notes: TPO alleges the Indian distributor created marketing intangibles for the brand owner and seeks an AMP adjustment plus mark-up; defence rests on the Sony Ericsson / bright-line line of reasoning.

cases.title: US–DE MAP — IP migration double taxation (competent authority)
cases.counterparty: IRS APMA ↔ German Federal Central Tax Office

checklist.label: File MAP request with both competent authorities
Submit position paper on the IP migration valuation
Reconcile statements of facts across both jurisdictions
Support competent-authority negotiation rounds

cases.notes: Germany asserted an exit-charge valuation on migrated IP that the US has already taxed; relief sought via the US–Germany treaty MAP article to eliminate double taxation.

cases.title: Canada–US MAP — intercompany services cost allocation

checklist.label: Agree the services cost base and allocation keys
Settle the arm's-length mark-up on the services
Compute correlative relief and interest
Execute the competent-authority closing agreement

cases.notes: Resolved: both authorities accepted a 5% cost-plus on the shared-services charge; correlative adjustment booked and the file is closed.

cases.title: EU principal restructuring — exit charge quantification (DE → IE)

checklist.label: Document pre/post functional and risk profile of the principal
Identify transferred profit potential and ongoing concern
Quantify the exit charge under OECD Chapter IX
Assess realistically available options for the German LRD
Update intercompany agreements and TP policy post-conversion

cases.notes: Conversion of the German principal to a limited-risk distributor with the entrepreneurial role moving to Ireland; the exit-charge magnitude is the gating issue for sign-off.

cases.title: Acquisition "NovaTher" — intercompany flow integration & policy harmonisation

checklist.label: Map acquired intercompany flows and existing TP policies
Identify policy gaps and conflicting methods vs. acquirer
Harmonise TP methods and draft transitional intercompany agreements
Reconcile purchase price allocation with go-forward IP ownership

cases.notes: Post-close integration of NovaTher's intercompany arrangements; exposure not yet quantified pending the flow mapping and PPA reconciliation.
